text: The Kentucky plant update: a software outage on the line. We're dark from next Tuesday through next Thursday; the line restarts the following working day.

incidents.span: Kentucky line    next Tuesday next Thursday the following working day

summary: E-04 is Plant outage. 9 production orders move (9 rescheduled, 0 transferred). 36 dealer notice(s) and 18 loaner assignment(s).
reasoning: Walked Plant P_KY → production orders scheduled 2027-03-09 through 2027-03-11 inclusive. 9 orders cannot build during the outage. The line restarts 2027-03-12. Rule 2 and rule 3. Placed 9 at the same plant and transferred 0. Rule 4: 36 dealer notice(s), one each, listing only affected customer orders. Rule 5: 18 loaner(s) for Platinum and Gold in priority order; 4 entitled order(s) left without a car because the pool ran out. Standard customers are on the dealer notice only. Guardrail: only orders, vehicles, dealers, and customers reached by the walk are touched. Shared slots and loaner pools are one board for the whole event, so a compound message cannot double-book them.

handoffs.did: Split the message into 1 incident(s) and dispatched specialists.
